hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A balanced index has equal sums of elements strictly to its left and strictly to its right.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Calculate the total sum of the array first.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Iterate from left to right while maintaining running left sum: check if left_sum == total - left_sum - nums[i].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Computes total sum and checks equilibrium condition in a single linear pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing subarray sums from scratch at every index takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses running prefix balance equation in linear time.
